violations.title: Food Manager Certificate & Responsibility
violations.observation: There is no Certified Food Manager present at the beginning of the inspection. Observed no CFM present at beginning of inspection.
violations.corrective_action: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager. It is highly suggested that you have more than one employee with the food manager's license. ORS Interactive, Inc. (see handout provided) issues the required photo identification card with proof of successful completion of a certified food manager's exam. Failure to have a certified food manager on site during ALL hours of operation including food preparation, food service, and cleaning/sanitizing of equipment/utensils will result in closure of the establishment. CFM arrived during inspection.

violations.title: Food Contact Surfaces Clean to Sight & Touch
violations.observation: The following equipment/utensils were observed soiled to sight and touch: round storage bin containing whole onions with accumulation of dirt/debris on interior.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be clean to the sight and touch. A surface that is soiled cannot be effectively sanitized. EHS instructed CFM to clean and sanitize interior of bin before using to store any food.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: boba in container observed at 93F, cooked chicken at 67F on countertop.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. EHS discussed with CFM using TPHC moving forward. EHS assisted CFM in labelling boba with discard time of 4:00PM, chicken labelled with discard time of 2:00PM. EHS and CFM completed TPHC agreement.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: cooked beef and cooked chicken in WIC prepared 2 days prior.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. EHS instructed CFM to label food containers with date prepared. Prepared food cannot be kept more than 7 days, including date prepared. Pho Ga Vang (Inspection Date: 05/11/2026) Page 2 of 4

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: frozen shrimp in container of water at 3 compartment sink.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. EHS instructed employee to move container of shrimp under faucet of cold running water while thawing.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: various containers of condiments, sauces, spices throughout kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. CFM will have employees label secondary containers with food name.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. OBSERVED 5 GALLON CONTAINERS OF VARIOUS FOODS STORED ON FLOOR OF WIC.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. CFM WILL ADJUST SHELVES SO BUCKETS CAN FIT ONTO SHELVING IN WIC.

violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. Clean floors, walls and ceilings. Move equipment to clean underneath units. Clean exterior of units.

violations.title: Designated Storage for Clothing, Possessions
violations.observation: Observed employee clothing and other possessions stored in areas that may contaminate food, food-contact surfaces of equipment, single-service items, or single- use items. Observed employee belongings stored on shelves throughout kitchen areas.
violations.corrective_action: Instruct employees to use the designated lockers and clothes hooks to prevent contamination of food, food equipment and utensils, and preparation surfaces. CFM will designate area for storage of employee belongings.

violations.title: Food Manager Certificate & Responsibility
violations.observation: There is no Certified Food Manager present in the establishment.
violations.corrective_action: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager. It is highly suggested that you have more than one employee with the food manager's license. ORS Interactive, Inc. (see handout provided) issues the required photo identification card with proof of successful completion of a certified food manager's exam. Failure to have a certified food manager on site during ALL hours of operation including food preparation, food service, and cleaning/sanitizing of equipment/utensils will result in closure of the establishment.

violations.title: Cleaning Procedure
violations.observation: Observed food employees using improper handwashing procedures. OBSERVED EMPLOYEE WASHING HANDS WITH WATER AND SHAKE HANDS TO DRY THEM.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall wash their hands and exposed portions of their arms by: 1) discarding used gloves; 2) rinsing under warm running water; 3) applying soap; 4) rubbing together for at least 10-15 seconds; 5) rinsing thoroughly under warm running water; and 6) drying with paper towels or air drying device. CDI: EMPLOYEE WAS INSTRUCTED TO PROPERLY WASH HANDS. Pho Ga Vang (Inspection Date: 11/14/2025) Page 2 of 5

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: OBSERVED HANDWASHING SINK IN PREP SPACE BEING USED TO STORE DIRTY DISHES.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. CDI: DIRTY DISHES MOVED TO SMALL THREE-VAT SINK.

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink. OBSERVED NO PAPER TOWELS AT BOTH HANDWASHING SINKS.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: OBSERVED RAW BEEF ON TOP OF CUT CABBAGE TWO-DOOR PREP-TOP IN PREP AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. CDI: BEEF AND CABBAGE DISPOSED OF DUE TO COLD HOLDING VIOLATION.

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: VARIOUS CERAMIC DISHWARE AND POTS. DISHWASHER STAFF WAS UTILIZING BLEACH MIXED WITH DISH SOAP TO WASH DISHES, RINSE, THEN PLACE ON RACK TO DRY.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. CDI: EHS SHOWED STAFF HOW TO WASH, RINSE, AND SANITIZE PROPERLY.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED COOKED BOBA IN METAL CONTAINER ON THE COUNTER AT 84F FOR 1HR.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. CDI: BOBA PLACED ON STOVE TO REHEAT. CEASE HOLDING TCS FOODS WITHOUT TEMPERATURE CONTROL.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED IN (4) WALK-IN FREEZER: RAW BEEF PACKAGES AT 50F OBSERVED IN (6) TWO-DOOR PREP-TOP: POPCORN CHICKEN AT 66F, CHICKEN STRIPS AT 44F, COOKED BOBA AT 54F, HALF AND HALF AT 64F, COFFEE W/MILK AT 59F. OBSERVED IN (7) RAW BEEF AT 45F, COOKED BEEF AT 44F, RAW SPROUTS AT 50F, CUT CABBAGE AT 55F. OBSERVED ON COUNTER IN PREP AREA: CUT LETTUCE AT 65F (2HR)
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI: ALL TCS FOODS OUT OF TEMPERATURE IN COOLING UNITS WERE DISPOSED OF. LETTUCE WAS PLACED IN WORKING COOLER.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking

violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food
violations.observation: A review of the menu with the foodservice operator indicates that there is no consumer advisory for the following food item(s) that may be served raw and/or undercooked: STEAK PHO. STAFF STATED STEAK PHO IS SERVED RAW OR PARTIALLY RAW IF CUSTOMER ORDERS IT. NO CONSUMER ADVISORY WAS OBSERVED ON THE MENU.
violations.corrective_action: If an animal food such as beef, eggs, fish, lamb, milk, pork, poultry, or shellfish is served or sold raw or undercooked the permit holder shall inform consumers of the significantly increased risk of consuming such foods by way of a disclosure and reminder using brochures, deli case or menu advisories, label statements, table tents, placards, or other effective written means. PLEASE ADD AN ASTERISK (*) NEXT TO STEAK PHO, AND AT THE BOTTOM OF THE MENU EHS RECOMMENDS ADDING THE FOLLOWING “THIS ITEM MAY BE SERVED UNDERCOOKED. CONSUMING RAW OR UNDERCOOKED MEATS, POULTRY, SEAFOOD, SHELLFISH, OR EGGS MAY INCREASE YOUR RISK OF FOODBORNE ILLNESS.
